info.name: Gets a list of all access tokens.

params.name: user
params.description: The ID of the user to filter access tokens

items.docs: Lists the currently available access tokens, providing basic information about each user.

info.name: Gets a information about a single access token.

params.name: token
params.description: The ID of the token to request info about

items.docs: Shows the selected access token, providing basic information about the token.

info.name: Deletes an access token by token id.

params.name: token
params.description: The ID of the access token to delete

items.docs:
Removes an access token from the list of available tokens.  The
access token will also be purged from the caches of all nodes
in the cluster

Creates a new access token.  This is not directly populated into the
token cache until it has been used.  Note that the response contains
fields which are not stored in the database in plaintext and cannot
be retrieved at a future date.
